The sibling fast_coxph_regression docstring at bindings_survival.cpp:200 says "Optional 1-based indices of fixed parameters." A Python user who passes 0-based indices fixes the wrong coefficient, or gets an exception for index 0. Suggested: Change the fixed_idx line of this docstring (line 278) to "Optional 1-based indices of fixed parameters." Lines 347, 433 and 561 carry the same text, so the old_text is not unique in the file. Check whether those three bindings also use make_fixed_param_spec and need the same edit. A human must make the edit because the job's automatic fix needs text that occurs once.
